manual_authority: Nintendo SNES Development Manual Book II sections 6.4, 6.5 and 6.7
type1_contract: SA-1 owns DCNT; S-CPU waits for CHRIRQ, owns shared descriptors and DMA7, performs no other BW-RAM reads until CHDEND; two aligned IRAM character buffers
type2_bug_fixed: SA-1 IRAM write permission is enabled before the first stack push; an uninitialized DBR previously depended on random stack bytes.
type1_observer_contract: The completed-transfer observer runs after an intervening instruction, covering deferred MDMA activation; byte-times are validated against bytes times eight.
scope: Source-neutral 2/4/8bpp packing and forced-blank VRAM delivery only. No SCREEN-to-PPU, production contention or gameplay admission.
